scenario.summary: Threat actors use the ARTEX agentic AI framework to harvest exposed secrets from GitHub and automate the compromise of Entra ID service principals. Once authenticated, the AI agents perform cloud resource discovery and adaptive API troubleshooting to exfiltrate sensitive data from Azure Key Vault, Storage Accounts, and Microsoft 365 environments.

meta.hypothesis: An adversary is using an agentic AI framework to automate cloud discovery and data exfiltration, identified by rapid, self-correcting API probing patterns and service principal abuse from campaign-associated infrastructure.

hunt.name: Agentic AI Cloud Resource Abuse (ARTEX)
hunt.description: This phased hunt targets the automated behaviors of agentic AI frameworks like ARTEX. It begins by identifying service principal sign-ins originating from known campaign IPs or Tor exit nodes. It then pivots to find the behavioral hallmark of AI agents: adaptive API troubleshooting, where the agent identifies and corrects its own API version or method errors (400 to 200 transitions) within seconds. Finally, an agent weighs the full lifecycle from compromise to discovery to exfiltration.

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE provider = 'azure_ad' AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify the reporting devices recorded in the authentication logs to establish a hunt scope.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames that have reported Entra ID sign-in events. Silence suggests a gap in cloud-to-host log forwarding.

config.content: SELECT time, actor_user_name, app_id, src_endpoint_ip, device_hostname, status FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND instr(',' || '{{suspicious_ips}}' || ',', ',' || src_endpoint_ip || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Correlate Entra ID authentication with the report's IP addresses and Tor exit nodes, filtered by the scoped devices.
config.expected_signal: Service principal or user logons from 199.19.77.84 or Tor nodes. Silence indicates no direct hits on the reported IPs.

config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS op_count, MIN(time) AS first_op FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (api_operation LIKE '%List%' OR api_operation LIKE '%Get%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING op_count > 10 ORDER BY op_count DESC
config.description: Identify identities performing high-frequency cloud resource enumeration.
config.expected_signal: Identities querying multiple subscriptions or resources in quick succession. Silence means no high-volume enumeration was captured.

primitive_config.label: Automated cloud discovery patterns
primitive_config.content: SELECT actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(*) AS op_count, MIN(time) AS first_op FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE (api_operation LIKE '%List%' OR api_operation LIKE '%Get%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY actor_user_name, api_operation, api_service_name, src_endpoint_ip HAVING op_count > 10 ORDER BY op_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Identities querying multiple subscriptions or resources in quick succession. Silence means no high-volume enumeration was captured.

config.objective: Identify service principals that have successfully authenticated from suspicious IPs and immediately transitioned to broad cloud discovery.
config.description: Identify service principals showing early signs of takeover by correlating malicious sign-ins with discovery behaviors.
config.expected_signal: A list of service principals confirmed as potentially compromised.
config.success_criteria: A per-identity verdict citing sign-in source and discovery volume.

config.content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT time, actor_user_name, api_operation, status, request_uri, src_endpoint_ip, LAG(status) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_user_name, api_operation ORDER BY time) as prev_status, LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_user_name, api_operation ORDER BY time) as prev_time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')) WHERE status = '200' AND prev_status = '400' AND (strftime('%s', time) - strftime('%s', prev_time)) <= 65
config.description: Detect the core behavioral signature of an AI agent: immediate self-correction after API failures.
config.expected_signal: An API request that fails (400) and is retried successfully (200) within 65 seconds by the same actor. This is the hallmark of agentic automation.

primitive_config.label: Adaptive API troubleshooting signature
primitive_config.content: SELECT * FROM (SELECT time, actor_user_name, api_operation, status, request_uri, src_endpoint_ip, LAG(status) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_user_name, api_operation ORDER BY time) as prev_status, LAG(time) OVER (PARTITION BY actor_user_name, api_operation ORDER BY time) as prev_time FROM hb_cloud_api_activity WHERE time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')) WHERE status = '200' AND prev_status = '400' AND (strftime('%s', time) - strftime('%s', prev_time)) <= 65
primitive_config.expected: An API request that fails (400) and is retried successfully (200) within 65 seconds by the same actor. This is the hallmark of agentic automation.
